definitions.explanation: The governmental power to make laws. In Japan it belongs to the Diet, as one of the three separated powers.

examples.japanese: {国会|こっかい}は{立法権|りっぽうけん}を{持|も}つ。
{立法権|りっぽうけん}は{国会|こっかい}に{属|ぞく}する。
examples.english: Legislative power belongs to the Diet.

examples.japanese: {三権分立|さんけんぶんりつ}では、{立法権|りっぽうけん}と{行政権|ぎょうせいけん}と{司法権|しほうけん}が{分|わ}けられている。
examples.english: Under the separation of powers, legislative, executive, and judicial powers are divided.

notes:
One of the three powers in {三権分立|さんけんぶんりつ} (the separation of powers). Compound of {立法|りっぽう} (legislation) and {権|けん} (right, power).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立法権|りっぽうけん}を{持|も}つ: to hold legislative power
- {立法権|りっぽうけん}は{国会|こっかい}に{属|ぞく}する: legislative power belongs to the Diet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行政権|ぎょうせいけん}: executive power — held by the Cabinet
- {司法権|しほうけん}: judicial power — held by the courts
